title: Future & Metro Boomin - LIKE THAT (Remix) [V1]
description: Remix to Future and Metro Boomin's song "Like That", with vocals from Ye, Ty, and The Hooligans, alongisde new production. Future also has an alternate verse taken from the original version of the song. DJ Pharris premiered the song censored and it was posted on yeezy.com for a very short period before it was later posted on YouTube. Written by Nayvadius Cash, Leland Wayne, Rodney Oliver, Kobe "BBYKOBE" Hood, Terrance "Zona Man" George, Ye, and Tyrone Griffin, Jr.. Engineered by Eric Maco, Ethan Stevens, Kourosh "MYBOYROACH" Poursalehi, Ray Charles Brown Jr. Johnathan Turner, Victor Luevanos, Aaron Fugeri, Jacob Stewart, Kayla DeWitt, Joe Laporta, and Rafael Fai Bautista. Mixed by Metro Boomin, Ethan Stevens, Rafael Fai Bautista, and The Legendary Traxster. Possibly intended to be released on the rumored deluxe to We Don't Trust You and We Still Don't Trust You, though that is likely not releasing anymore. If the Drake Kendrick beef continued, the song would've been released a week earlier to promote the release of the album like "TALKING".
